recipes.title: Baked Cod Fish
steps: Season the cod with either the basic season (salt, lemon juice, olive oil, cayenne pepper) or the other season (old bay, olive oil, cayenne pepper).
Bake at 400°F for 10 min.

recipes.title: Eggplant Saltyfish
ingredients: Soy sauce + water mix (add a little oil at the end)
steps: Prep: steam the salty fish, remove bones, and mince it.
Prep eggplant: slice.
Add oil, fry the pork - don't move it when it's in the wok.
Flip, make it a patty, then break it up.
Add ginger and garlic, fry.
Add cooking wine, 1 tbsp.
Add some water to cover the pork.
Add pepper powder, a little.
Add half teaspoon sugar.
Add 1 tbsp oyster sauce.
Boil, cook.
Add eggplant (steam the eggplant? not sure).
Add salt fish mix.
Add cilantro on top, fry.
Fry till good.

recipes.title: Fried Shrimp
steps: Make the sauce: mix Japanese mayo, wasabi sauce, mint leaf, and lemon juice.
Marinate the shrimp: bread it, add salt + pepper, 1 egg yolk, and mix.
Fry at 160°C.
Mix together.

recipes.title: Miso Black Cod
steps: Boil sake + mirin for 20 sec, turn heat to low, add miso paste. Dissolve paste, turn to high and add sugar. Once sugar dissolved, remove from heat.
Dry fish, marinate for 2 days.
400F oven. Wipe off excess miso, don't rinse it off.
In a pan, fish skin side up (high heat), cook 3 min or until it turns brown. Flip, another 3 min.
Transfer to oven 5-10 min until skin is opaque / flaky.

recipes.title: Pan Fry Fluke
recipes.description: Fluke quick marinate. Tip: wrap in paper towel to help keep it fresh.
steps: Quick marinate: soy sauce, sesame oil, onion powder, garlic powder, chili powder. Marinate 15-20 min.
Pan-fry.

recipes.title: poke shoyu tuna
steps: Dice tuna, mix all, and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Cheese Sauce
steps: Cook shrimp with salt, then remove shrimp.
In pan, butter -> melt butter + garlic.
Mix in white wine, heavy cream, and cheese.
Reduce, then add salt + Italian herb.
Mix and serve.

recipes.title: Shrimp and vermicili pot
steps: Heat oil, add to garlic.
Soak vermicelli noodle for 20 min.
Use shell to make stock - fry shell, add water and boil for 8 min on high heat.
Vermicelli on top.
